title: Lighter traffic in live shared rooms
summary: Map pings, actions and returning to a tab no longer re-download the whole campaign when nothing changed, so busy live tables stay quicker for everyone.
items: An open map checks for pings every second while pings are flying and every three seconds when the map is quiet; switching back to the tab checks at once.
Pings now check only the room's seats and the one map you're on, with the same rules for who sees what.
Before an action, and when you return to the window, the room is only downloaded again if someone changed it.
Chat notifications to other players are sent after your message is saved, so a slow notification service no longer holds up your table.
During a server hiccup, a failed update check waits and tries again instead of downloading the whole room.
